decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed change of use of premises to bed and breakfast would, by reason of its location, which is not near a town centre close to public transport and a range of social and community facilities, noise and disturbance, have a significant adverse impact on the amenities of the adjoining residents and the local area. The proposal is contrary to policies ENV.1.1 (All New development) and H.4.6 (Bed and Breakfast) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New development) and H.7.4 (Bed and Breakfast) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The applicant has failed to demonstrate that adequate access is available to the proposed garages to the rear of the premises and to the front parking spaces. The proposal could therefore lead to on-street parking and conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic. The proposal is contrary to policies ENV1.1 (All New Development) and T.2.5 (Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and T.1.4 (Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit
description: Change of use of premises to bed and breakfast with 3 parking spaces at front of premises and retention and conversion of existing outbuilding for proposed use as two garages
